subject: Global: Move ArmLib to MdePkg
reasons: The C/asm source files are simply renamed (moved) with no code changes — Coccinelle cannot express file renames.

The DSC file changes are highly repetitive (replacing 'ArmLib|ArmPkg/Library/ArmLib/ArmBaseLib.inf' with 'ArmLib|MdePkg/Library/ArmLib/ArmBaseLib.inf' across ~12 DSC files), but DSC files are not C code and Coccinelle only handles C.
The one C-level change is just removing an #include of ArmPkg.dec from the INF — again a build descriptor, not C code.
While the string substitution is very regular, it targets build system files outside Coccinelle's domain.
